dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Gladly, beats standing here twiddling my thumbs.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Hey, do you know about the siltwater lakes in the desert?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are they like the ones at Sobek Oasis?

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Siltwater lakes usually appear farther inside the desert. According to some very tall tales, they're believed to be Al-Ahmar's blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Legend has it that when his followers got lost in the desert, Al-Ahmar would command the underground rivers to rise to the surface, forming lakes for the trapped to quench their thirst...

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: But it's just an urban legend.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: The water in siltwater lakes does originate from groundwater, but it's too bitter to be used for drinking.

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Besides, these lakes only exist for a short time before they're buried by sand, so you can't use them as landmarks.

choices.text: So do they have any purpose?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: I heard that the Adventurers' Guild did once receive a commission related to siltwater lakes.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: As for what the commission was about... I guess some outlanders who were visiting Sumeru wanted to visit the desert and see these lakes for themselves.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: So, they hired a group of experienced Guild adventurers to escort them through the desert.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: After that... Well, some say the Adventurers' Guild has never accepted similar commissions ever since.

choices.text: Other than being treated as tourist attractions...
